description_en: After you add a user to your bastion host, you must authorize the user to manage assets. Only authorized users can log on to the bastion host to perform O\\\\\\\\\\\\&M operations on the assets
description_zh: 当您新建用户之后，您需要为该用户授权资产。授权后该用户才可以使用堡垒机运维已授权的资产
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost attach-host-accounts-to-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-id 1 --hosts HostId_:_1_,_HostId_:_2_,_HostAccountIds_:_1_,_2_,_3_,_HostId_:_3_,_HostAccountIds_:_4_,_5_,_6_,_HostId_:_4_,_HostAccountIds_:_9_,_8_,_7 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachHostAccountsToUser

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host for which you want to authorize the user to manage the hosts and host accounts.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要授权主机和主机账户的用户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host for which you want to authorize the user to manage the hosts and host accounts.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要授权主机和主机账户的用户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user that you want to authorize to manage the hosts and host accounts.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to query the ID of the user
parameters.help_zh:
指定要授权主机和主机账户的用户ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the hosts and host accounts that you want to authorize the user to manage. You can specify up to 10 host IDs and up to 10 host account IDs for each host. You can specify only host IDs. In this case, the user is authorized to manage only the specified hosts. For more information about this parameter, see the "Description of the Hosts parameter" section of this topic.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query the ID of the host and the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html operation to query the ID of the host account
parameters.help_zh:
要为用户授权的主机ID和主机账户ID。最多支持设置10个主机ID，每个主机最多支持设置9个主机账户ID。您可以不设置主机账户ID，不设置主机账户ID表示仅为用户授权主机。该参数的具体结构请参考请求参数列表下的Hosts参数结构说明。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取主机ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html接口获取主机账户ID
parameters.name: hosts
